questions: How many bars, chips and cooldowns did you measure, and how many showed a field-free diode whose sign follows the [100] preparation field?
Why were the others set aside?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: [100] preparation fields beyond ±1 T for the diode (your Fig. 3e goes to ±4 T along [010]), temperatures above base, and small applied fields around zero?
What does the second-best bar or cooldown look like, beyond the [100] bar in Extended Data Fig. 4?

What is the field at the sample at the nominal H = 0 after a ±1 T excursion, and did you calibrate the magnet's remanent field with an independent sensor? Were both bars on one chip, aligned to the same magnet coils?
Does the prepared diode sign survive warming the bar above the Al transition (far below the 480 K Néel temperature) and cooling again at zero field?

Your Fig. 3b axis runs from 16 to 23 µA, while the ZFC distributions in Fig. 3a sit near 27 to 31 µA. If the switching currents after a 1 T excursion are lower than after zero-field cooling, what sets that drop?
Did you take an Reven readout, or any other Néel-state readout, on the CuMnAs/AlAs/Al bar itself, in the same cryostat and magnet as the diode data?
